name: Heron Renaude
source: A professor of medicine, Heron is a forward thinking and intelligent man. He is, however, rather blunt, though friendly if one can withstand his acerbic wit. In other people, he celebrates honesty and integrity over intelligence. He is a friend of Taylor Ashbrook, the protagonist’s older brother, and it’s through him that the protagonist originally met Heron some time ago.
